SELECT tenant_id AS tenantId, member_id AS memberId, member_no AS memberNo, home_store_id AS homeStoreId, mobile, real_name AS realName, nickname, avatar_url AS avatarUrl, member_status AS memberStatus FROM fit_member WHERE del_flag = '0' AND mobile = #{mobile} LIMIT 1

SELECT tenant_id AS tenantId, member_id AS memberId, member_no AS memberNo, home_store_id AS homeStoreId, mobile, real_name AS realName, nickname, avatar_url AS avatarUrl, member_status AS memberStatus FROM fit_member WHERE del_flag = '0' AND member_id = #{memberId} LIMIT 1

SELECT member_id AS memberId, member_no AS memberNo, home_store_id AS homeStoreId, mobile, real_name AS realName, nickname, gender, birthday, avatar_url AS avatarUrl, member_status AS memberStatus, remark FROM fit_member WHERE del_flag = '0' AND member_id = #{memberId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fit_member( member_id, tenant_id, member_no, home_store_id, mobile, real_name, nickname, avatar_url, wx_openid, wx_unionid, register_source, member_status, remark, create_time, update_time, del_flag, version ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{tenantId}, #{memberNo}, #{bo.homeStoreId}, #{bo.mobile}, #{bo.realName}, #{bo.nickname}, #{bo.avatarUrl}, #{bo.openid}, #{bo.unionId}, 'mini', 'normal', #{bo.remark}, NOW(), NOW(), '0', 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE fit_member SET wx_openid = #{bo.openid}, wx_unionid = #{bo.unionId}, nickname = CASE WHEN #{bo.nickname} IS NOT NULL AND #{bo.nickname} != '' THEN #{bo.nickname} ELSE nickname END, avatar_url = CASE WHEN #{bo.avatarUrl} IS NOT NULL AND #{bo.avatarUrl} != '' THEN #{bo.avatarUrl} ELSE avatar_url END, real_name = CASE WHEN #{bo.realName} IS NOT NULL AND #{bo.realName} != '' THEN #{bo.realName} ELSE real_name END, mobile = CASE WHEN #{bo.mobile} IS NOT NULL AND #{bo.mobile} != '' THEN #{bo.mobile} ELSE mobile END, home_store_id = CASE WHEN #{bo.homeStoreId} IS NOT NULL THEN #{bo.homeStoreId} ELSE home_store_id END, update_time = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND del_flag = '0'

UPDATE fit_member SET mobile = #{bo.mobile}, real_name = CASE WHEN #{bo.realName} IS NOT NULL AND #{bo.realName} != '' THEN #{bo.realName} ELSE real_name END, update_time = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND del_flag = '0'

UPDATE fit_member SET real_name = CASE WHEN #{bo.realName} IS NOT NULL AND #{bo.realName} != '' THEN #{bo.realName} ELSE real_name END, nickname = CASE WHEN #{bo.nickname} IS NOT NULL AND #{bo.nickname} != '' THEN #{bo.nickname} ELSE nickname END, gender = CASE WHEN #{bo.gender} IS NOT NULL AND #{bo.gender} != '' THEN #{bo.gender} ELSE gender END, birthday = CASE WHEN #{bo.birthday} IS NOT NULL THEN #{bo.birthday} ELSE birthday END, avatar_url = CASE WHEN #{bo.avatarUrl} IS NOT NULL AND #{bo.avatarUrl} != '' THEN #{bo.avatarUrl} ELSE avatar_url END, remark = CASE WHEN #{bo.remark} IS NOT NULL THEN #{bo.remark} ELSE remark END, update_time = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: SELECT m.member_id AS memberId, m.real_name AS realName, m.nickname, m.mobile, m.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM fit_course_reservation r WHERE r.del_flag = '0' AND r.member_id = m.member_id), 0) AS totalReservationCount, IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM fit_course_reservation r WHERE r.del_flag = '0' AND r.member_id = m.member_id AND r.reservation_status = 'reserved'), 0) AS pendingReservationCount, IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM fit_member_card mc WHERE mc.del_flag = '0' AND mc.member_id = m.member_id), 0) AS totalCardCount, IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM fit_member_card mc WHERE mc.del_flag = '0' AND mc.member_id = m.member_id AND mc.card_status IN ('unused', 'active')), 0) AS activeCardCount, IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM fit_checkin_record c WHERE c.del_flag = '0' AND c.member_id = m.member_id AND c.checkin_status = 'success' AND c.operator_user_id IS NULL), 0) AS pendingConfirmCount, IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM fit_checkin_record c WHERE c.del_flag = '0' AND c.member_id = m.member_id AND c.checkin_status = 'success' AND c.operator_user_id IS NOT NULL), 0) AS confirmedCheckinCount FROM fit_member m WHERE m.del_flag = '0' AND m.member_id = #{memberId} LIMIT 1

SELECT s.store_id AS storeId, s.store_code AS storeCode, s.store_name AS storeName, s.store_short_name AS storeShortName, s.contact_name AS contactName, s.contact_phone AS contactPhone, s.address, s.business_hours AS businessHours, s.cover_url AS coverUrl, s.status, CASE WHEN s.store_id = m.home_store_id THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS homeStore FROM fit_store s LEFT JOIN fit_member m ON m.member_id = #{memberId} AND m.del_flag = '0' WHERE s.del_flag = '0' AND s.status = '0'
AND (s.store_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.store_short_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY homeStore DESC, s.store_id DESC

SELECT s.store_id AS storeId, s.store_code AS storeCode, s.store_name AS storeName, s.store_short_name AS storeShortName, s.contact_name AS contactName, s.contact_phone AS contactPhone, s.address, s.business_hours AS businessHours, s.cover_url AS coverUrl, s.status, CASE WHEN s.store_id = m.home_store_id THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS homeStore FROM fit_store s LEFT JOIN fit_member m ON m.member_id = #{memberId} AND m.del_flag = '0' WHERE s.del_flag = '0' AND s.store_id = #{storeId} LIMIT 1

SELECT c.course_id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, c.course_type AS courseType, c.store_id AS storeId, s.store_name AS storeName, c.default_coach_id AS defaultCoachId, coach.coach_name AS coachName, c.duration_minutes AS durationMinutes, c.capacity, c.cover_url AS coverUrl, c.description, c.support_card_type AS supportCardType, c.status FROM fit_course c LEFT JOIN fit_store s ON s.store_id = c.store_id AND s.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_coach coach ON coach.coach_id = c.default_coach_id AND coach.del_flag = '0' WHERE c.del_flag = '0' AND c.course_id = #{courseId} LIMIT 1

SELECT c.course_id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, c.course_type AS courseType, c.store_id AS storeId, s.store_name AS storeName, c.default_coach_id AS defaultCoachId, coach.coach_name AS coachName, c.duration_minutes AS durationMinutes, c.capacity, c.cover_url AS coverUrl, c.description, c.support_card_type AS supportCardType, c.status FROM fit_course c LEFT JOIN fit_store s ON s.store_id = c.store_id AND s.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_coach coach ON coach.coach_id = c.default_coach_id AND coach.del_flag = '0' WHERE c.del_flag = '0' AND c.status = '0' AND c.course_type NOT IN ('private', 'small') ORDER BY c.course_id DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT r.tenant_id AS tenantId, r.reservation_id AS reservationId, r.store_id AS storeId, r.schedule_id AS scheduleId, r.member_id AS memberId, r.card_id AS cardId, r.reservation_type AS reservationType, mc.plan_type AS planType, mc.bind_coach_id AS bindCoachId, st.store_name AS storeName,
c.course_id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, c.course_type AS courseType, s.coach_id AS coachId, coach.coach_name AS coachName, s.schedule_date AS scheduleDate, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, s.reservation_deadline AS reservationDeadline, s.cancel_deadline AS cancelDeadline, s.schedule_status AS scheduleStatus, r.reservation_status AS reservationStatus, s.capacity, s.reserved_count AS reservedCount FROM fit_course_reservation r INNER JOIN fit_course_schedule s ON s.schedule_id = r.schedule_id AND s.del_flag = '0' INNER JOIN fit_course c ON c.course_id = s.course_id AND c.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_store st ON st.store_id = r.store_id AND st.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_member_card mc ON mc.card_id = r.card_id AND mc.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_coach coach ON coach.coach_id = s.coach_id AND coach.del_flag = '0' WHERE r.del_flag = '0'
AND r.member_id = #{memberId} AND r.reservation_id = #{reservationId} LIMIT 1

SELECT s.tenant_id AS tenantId, NULL AS reservationId, s.store_id AS storeId, s.schedule_id AS scheduleId, #{memberId} AS memberId, NULL AS cardId, 'store_experience' AS reservationType, NULL AS planType, NULL AS bindCoachId, st.store_name AS storeName,
c.course_id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, c.course_type AS courseType, s.coach_id AS coachId, coach.coach_name AS coachName, s.schedule_date AS scheduleDate, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, s.reservation_deadline AS reservationDeadline, s.cancel_deadline AS cancelDeadline, s.schedule_status AS scheduleStatus, 'reserved' AS reservationStatus, s.capacity, s.reserved_count AS reservedCount FROM fit_course_schedule s INNER JOIN fit_course c ON c.course_id = s.course_id AND c.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_store st ON st.store_id = s.store_id AND st.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_coach coach ON coach.coach_id = s.coach_id AND coach.del_flag = '0' WHERE s.del_flag = '0' AND s.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} LIMIT 1

SELECT mc.card_id AS cardId, mc.plan_id AS planId, mc.card_no AS cardNo, mc.card_name AS cardName, mc.plan_type AS planType, mc.bind_coach_id AS bindCoachId, coach.coach_name AS coachName, mc.active_time AS activeTime, mc.expire_time AS expireTime, mc.total_times AS totalTimes, mc.used_times AS usedTimes, mc.remain_times AS remainTimes, mc.balance_amount AS balanceAmount, mc.card_status AS cardStatus FROM fit_member_card mc LEFT JOIN fit_coach coach ON coach.coach_id = mc.bind_coach_id AND coach.del_flag = '0' WHERE mc.del_flag = '0' AND mc.member_id = #{memberId} AND mc.card_id = #{cardId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fit_course_reservation( reservation_id, reservation_no, tenant_id, store_id, schedule_id, member_id, card_id, reservation_type, reservation_source, reservation_status, reservation_time, consume_mode, remark, create_time, update_time, del_flag, version ) VALUES ( #{reservationId}, #{reservationNo}, #{tenantId}, #{storeId}, #{scheduleId}, #{memberId}, #{cardId}, #{reservationType}, 'mini', 'reserved', #{reservationTime}, #{consumeMode}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW(), '0', 0 )

UPDATE fit_course_schedule SET reserved_count = CASE WHEN reserved_count + #{delta} < 0 THEN 0 ELSE reserved_count + #{delta} END, update_time = NOW() WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT r.reservation_id AS reservationId, r.schedule_id AS scheduleId, r.store_id AS storeId, st.store_name AS storeName, s.course_id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, c.course_type AS courseType, s.coach_id AS coachId, coach.coach_name AS coachName, s.schedule_date AS scheduleDate, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, r.card_id AS cardId, r.reservation_type AS reservationType, mc.card_name AS cardName, mc.plan_type AS planType, r.reservation_status AS reservationStatus, r.reservation_time AS reservationTime, r.cancel_time AS cancelTime, r.cancel_reason AS cancelReason, cr.checkin_id AS checkinId, cr.checkin_time AS checkinTime, cr.operator_user_id AS operatorUserId, cr.checkin_status AS checkinStatus
FROM fit_course_reservation r INNER JOIN fit_course_schedule s ON s.schedule_id = r.schedule_id AND s.del_flag = '0' INNER JOIN fit_course c ON c.course_id = s.course_id AND c.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_store st ON st.store_id = r.store_id AND st.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_coach coach ON coach.coach_id = s.coach_id AND coach.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_member_card mc ON mc.card_id = r.card_id AND mc.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_checkin_record cr ON cr.reservation_id = r.reservation_id AND cr.del_flag = '0' WHERE r.del_flag = '0' AND r.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY r.reservation_time DESC, r.reservation_id DESC

SELECT r.reservation_id AS reservationId, r.schedule_id AS scheduleId, r.store_id AS storeId, st.store_name AS storeName, s.course_id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, c.course_type AS courseType, s.coach_id AS coachId, coach.coach_name AS coachName, s.schedule_date AS scheduleDate, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, r.card_id AS cardId, r.reservation_type AS reservationType, mc.card_name AS cardName, mc.plan_type AS planType, r.reservation_status AS reservationStatus, r.reservation_time AS reservationTime, r.cancel_time AS cancelTime, r.cancel_reason AS cancelReason, cr.checkin_id AS checkinId, cr.checkin_time AS checkinTime, cr.operator_user_id AS operatorUserId, cr.checkin_status AS checkinStatus
FROM fit_course_reservation r INNER JOIN fit_course_schedule s ON s.schedule_id = r.schedule_id AND s.del_flag = '0' INNER JOIN fit_course c ON c.course_id = s.course_id AND c.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_store st ON st.store_id = r.store_id AND st.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_coach coach ON coach.coach_id = s.coach_id AND coach.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_member_card mc ON mc.card_id = r.card_id AND mc.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_checkin_record cr ON cr.reservation_id = r.reservation_id AND cr.del_flag = '0' WHERE r.del_flag = '0' AND r.member_id = #{memberId} AND r.reservation_id = #{reservationId} LIMIT 1

SELECT p.plan_id AS planId, p.store_id AS storeId, st.store_name AS storeName, p.plan_name AS planName, p.plan_type AS planType, p.sale_price AS salePrice, p.original_price AS originalPrice, p.valid_days AS validDays, p.total_times AS totalTimes, p.gift_times AS giftTimes, p.stored_amount AS storedAmount, p.support_course_type AS supportCourseType, p.is_private_bind_coach AS isPrivateBindCoach, p.status FROM fit_card_plan p LEFT JOIN fit_store st ON st.store_id = p.store_id AND st.del_flag = '0' WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND p.plan_id = #{planId} LIMIT 1

SELECT a.activity_id AS activityId, a.activity_no AS activityNo, a.store_id AS storeId, st.store_name AS storeName, st.contact_phone AS storeContactPhone, a.title, a.sub_title AS subTitle, a.price_highlight AS priceHighlight, a.target_audience AS targetAudience, a.cover_url AS coverUrl, a.detail_image_url AS detailImageUrl, a.detail_content AS detailContent, a.start_time AS startTime, a.end_time AS endTime, a.countdown_end_time AS countdownEndTime, a.weekly_featured AS weeklyFeatured, a.activity_type AS activityType, a.action_type AS actionType, a.discount_label AS discountLabel, a.rule_note AS ruleNote, a.sort_no AS sortNo, a.status FROM fit_activity a LEFT JOIN fit_store st ON st.store_id = a.store_id AND st.del_flag = '0' WHERE a.del_flag = '0' AND a.status = '0' AND NOW() >= a.start_time AND NOW() <= a.end_time AND (a.store_id IS NULL OR a.store_id = #{storeId} OR #{storeId} IS NULL) ORDER BY a.weekly_featured DESC, a.sort_no ASC, a.activity_id DESC

SELECT a.activity_id AS activityId, a.activity_no AS activityNo, a.store_id AS storeId, st.store_name AS storeName, st.contact_phone AS storeContactPhone, a.title, a.sub_title AS subTitle, a.price_highlight AS priceHighlight, a.target_audience AS targetAudience, a.cover_url AS coverUrl, a.detail_image_url AS detailImageUrl, a.detail_content AS detailContent, a.start_time AS startTime, a.end_time AS endTime, a.countdown_end_time AS countdownEndTime, a.weekly_featured AS weeklyFeatured, a.activity_type AS activityType, a.action_type AS actionType, a.discount_label AS discountLabel, a.rule_note AS ruleNote, a.sort_no AS sortNo, a.status FROM fit_activity a LEFT JOIN fit_store st ON st.store_id = a.store_id AND st.del_flag = '0' WHERE a.del_flag = '0' AND a.status = '0' AND a.activity_id = #{activityId} LIMIT 1

SELECT p.plan_id AS planId, p.store_id AS storeId, st.store_name AS storeName, p.plan_name AS planName, p.plan_type AS planType, p.sale_price AS salePrice, p.original_price AS originalPrice, p.valid_days AS validDays, p.total_times AS totalTimes, p.gift_times AS giftTimes, p.stored_amount AS storedAmount, p.support_course_type AS supportCourseType, p.is_private_bind_coach AS isPrivateBindCoach, p.status, a.discount_label AS discountLabel, a.rule_note AS ruleNote FROM fit_activity_plan ap INNER JOIN fit_activity a ON a.activity_id = ap.activity_id AND a.del_flag = '0' INNER JOIN fit_card_plan p ON p.plan_id = ap.plan_id AND p.del_flag = '0' AND p.status = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_store st ON st.store_id = p.store_id AND st.del_flag = '0' WHERE ap.activity_id = #{activityId} ORDER BY ap.sort_no ASC, p.sort_no ASC, p.plan_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fit_order( order_id, tenant_id, store_id, order_no, member_id, order_type, order_source, order_status, pay_method, total_amount, discount_amount, payable_amount, paid_amount, paid_time, remark, create_time, update_time, del_flag, version ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{tenantId}, #{storeId}, #{orderNo}, #{memberId}, #{orderType}, 'mini', #{orderStatus}, #{payMethod}, #{totalAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{payableAmount}, #{paidAmount}, #{paidTime}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW(), '0', 0 )

INSERT INTO fit_member_card( card_id, tenant_id, store_id, member_id, plan_id, card_no, card_name, plan_type, bind_coach_id, active_time, expire_time, total_times, used_times, remain_times, balance_amount, card_status, order_id, create_time, update_time, del_flag, version ) VALUES ( #{cardId}, #{tenantId}, #{storeId}, #{memberId}, #{plan.planId}, #{cardNo}, #{plan.planName}, #{plan.planType}, #{bindCoachId}, #{activeTime}, #{expireTime}, #{totalTimes}, 0, #{totalTimes}, #{balanceAmount}, #{cardStatus}, #{orderId}, NOW(), NOW(), '0', 0 )

SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.store_id AS storeId, st.store_name AS storeName, o.order_type AS orderType, o.order_source AS orderSource, o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.pay_method AS payMethod, o.total_amount AS totalAmount, o.discount_amount AS discountAmount, o.payable_amount AS payableAmount, o.paid_amount AS paidAmount, o.paid_time AS paidTime, o.create_time AS createTime FROM fit_order o LEFT JOIN fit_store st ON st.store_id = o.store_id AND st.del_flag = '0' WHERE o.del_flag = '0' AND o.member_id = #{memberId} AND o.order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1

SELECT item_id AS itemId, item_no AS itemNo, item_type AS itemType, item_ref_id AS itemRefId, item_name AS itemName, quantity, unit_price AS unitPrice, total_price AS totalPrice, discount_amount AS discountAmount, real_amount AS realAmount, grant_card_id AS grantCardId FROM fit_order_item WHERE del_flag = '0' AND order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY item_id ASC

mapper.select: SELECT cr.checkin_id AS checkinId, cr.reservation_id AS reservationId, cr.schedule_id AS scheduleId, cr.member_id AS memberId, COALESCE(m.real_name, m.nickname) AS memberName, c.course_name AS courseName, coach.coach_name AS coachName, cr.card_id AS cardId, mc.card_name AS cardName, s.schedule_date AS scheduleDate, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, cr.checkin_time AS checkinTime, cr.consume_times AS consumeTimes, cr.consume_amount AS consumeAmount, cr.operator_user_id AS operatorUserId, cr.checkin_status AS checkinStatus, cr.remark FROM fit_checkin_record cr INNER JOIN fit_course_schedule s ON s.schedule_id = cr.schedule_id AND s.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_course c ON c.course_id = s.course_id AND c.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_coach coach ON coach.coach_id = s.coach_id AND coach.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_member m ON m.member_id = cr.member_id AND m.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_member_card mc ON mc.card_id = cr.card_id AND mc.del_flag = '0' WHERE cr.del_flag = '0' AND cr.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY cr.checkin_time DESC, cr.checkin_id DESC
